articles.title: 78-Year-Old Fortnite Streaming Grandmother Now Holds a World Record
articles.summary: Cath Bowie, a 78-year-old grandmother, now holds a world record for Fortnite streaming. The Scottish septuagenarian — better known online as Grumpygran1948 — has been officially decreed as the world's oldest Fortnite streamer (female) by Guinness World Records.
body: Speaking to BBC News, the gaming grandma said she had been introduced to the game by her teenage grandson, who initially told her that nobody would watch a grandmother playing Fortnite — something she then took as a challenge.

"He just couldn't believe that his grandma would do such a thing and suggested that nobody would join me or watch me," Bowie said. "Saying that was like a red rag to a bull to me. I would show him that I could do it.
"Twenty four thousand followers later and he doesn't mention it," she continued. "I wonder why?"

Now, Bowie plays with others from across the world, and streams daily via YouTube and Twitch. Her achievement has also now been recognized by Fortnite developer Epic Games, which has described her as a "goat."

articles.title: Pokémon's 30th Anniversary Happy Meal Toy Will Unleash Scalper Hell
articles.summary: As part of Pokémon 's 30th anniversary celebrations, the company is collaborating with McDonald's once again to bring Pokémon Trading Card Game cards to Happy Meals. It's almost a certainty that scalpers will be working overtime to catch 'em all.
body: Each Happy Meal will include a four-card booster pack, containing one holographic card and three regular cards. Fans will have to find 15 different cards to complete this collection. Six cards in the collection will be special confetti holofoil cards, which will likely make them the most sought-after. While some details have been revealed, the cards themselves remain unseen as the collab is still some time away. The promotional campaign is set to run from Nov. 5 until Dec. 9.

This isn't the first time that McDonald's has given away Pokémon TCG cards as the Happy Meal toy option, but previous promotions haven't gone well. It is a fun idea that should work well in theory, but in practice, it is often ruined by impatient gamers and scalpers looking to profit.

If these scenarios become a reality, McDonald's will have to find a way to prevent customers from buying more than a certain number of Happy Meals per day. Otherwise, it'll become impossible for children to complete the collection.

articles.title: The Mummy 4 Set Photos Reveal Rachel Weisz as Evelyn O'Connell, Suggest Time Period
articles.summary: Set photos have revealed Rachel Weisz reprising her role as Evelyn O'Connell in the upcoming The Mummy movie. As reported by the Daily Mail, the 56-year-old actress was spotted in costume as librarian, Egyptologist, and action heroine Evelyn O'Connell in London.
body: Weisz stars in the new The Mummy alongside Brendan Fraser nearly 20 years after the last The Mummy movie, 2008’s Tomb of the Dragon Emperor, came out. Weisz didn't appear in that divisive third entry (Maria Bello played the character instead). In March, director duo Matt Bettinelli-Olpin and Tyler Gillett suggested Tomb of the Dragon isn't considered canon.

Last year, Fraser, who plays Rick O'Connell, pointed to the power of stunt men ahead of filming. The 57-year-old sustained multiple injuries during the filming of The Mummy movies, including a torn spinal disc and a cracked rib, which led to numerous surgeries over several years. These injuries and surgeries took a significant toll on his health, and played a part in the actor taking a long break from his career.

Meanwhile, John Hannah will reprise his role as Jonathan Carnahan, the unscrupulous brother of Evelyn O'Connell. Hannah appeared in the first three Mummy movies. Elsewhere, Oded Fehr returns as Ardeth Bay.

articles.title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Episode Count and Streaming Details Teased by New Leaks
articles.summary: It's a strange time to be a Dragon Ball fan. For the first time in years, the franchise will not be featured at Jump Festa, the yearly showcase held by the manga's publisher, Shueisha.
body: While the anime will barely offer anything new in terms of story, fans are still understandably excited to see Dragon Ball on air again with a new, enhanced visual presentation. Speculation has run rampant about how long this new series will run and which arcs of the original anime it will cover. Moreover, an official streaming platform outside of Japan has not been announced yet, but a new rumor could finally answer all these questions.

On Sept. 28, the account @SugoiLITE shared in a post on X that Dragon Ball Super: Beerus will have a total of 19 episodes, divided into three arcs: God of Destruction Beerus arc, Frieza's Revival arc, and Universe Six arc. This is coherent with previous reports that mentioned a total of about 20 episodes and these three arcs specifically. If confirmed, this means that the anime will be on air until February 2027 with a weekly episode release. The post also adds that Crunchyroll will be streaming the show one hour after it airs in Japan, something that the platform has not yet officially confirmed.

articles.title: As World of Warcraft: Forever's beta popularity grows, Blizzard has yet again had to increase the server cap
articles.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever's beta appears to be growing in popularity, as one of Blizzard's leads has revealed the server capacity had to be increased over the weekend.
body: Holly Longdale, executive producer of World of Warcraft at Blizzard, announced the news on her personal X account. She wrote: "So... we had to increase the WoW: Forever Beta population cap again. The wild ride continues."

The game already showed signs of being exceptionally popular, even without this latest post from Longdale. Last week, immediately after the beta went live, long-time World of Warcraft: Classic developer Josh Greenfield said the beta led to the "craziest numbers I've seen in 17 years working at Blizzard and almost 8 years on classic."

It's worth noting that this World of Warcraft: Forever beta requires a player to pay £51.99 / $59.99 / €59.99 for the Skyborne Epic pack. When it launches fully on the 4th November, the cost of entry will be a monthly subscription rather than a hefty one-time purchase. As such, these player figures are expected to grow significantly.

articles.title: Marvel's Wolverine finally lets you turn off "fart gas" scent trails completely, but there's a catch
articles.summary: Marvel's Wolverine has received a new update that should hopefully bring an end to the "fart gas" scent trails saga. The latest patch, version 1.001.006, includes an option to turn off scent trails for Whiskey Bottle collectibles, Material Crate audio pings as well as Nightmare Door roots using…
body: Senses will remain for what developer Insomniac Games described in the patch notes as "story-critical" moments, but that should at least be enough to limit how often they are a nuisance.

The game's ever-visible, bright-lit blue trails are meant to help players navigate to the next mission objective and locate collectibles hidden around levels. However, their implementation has been controversial, as many players saw them as unnecessary given how linear the game's levels typically are.

Even before Marvel's Wolverine came out, players asked for a way to turn them off, and though the studio initially released a hotfix to lessen their effect so they're less visible in the world, the game's latest patch delivers on the developer's promise to explore adding an option to turn them off entirely.

Elsewhere in the patch notes, a number of crashes players reported have been fixed, alongside instances where the player could become stuck. Patch 1.001.006 also addresses the overlapping bathroom sign in the casino level, which sparked accusations of generative AI use online.

articles.title: "We clearly handled that responsibility poorly": Paradox ban Discord profile pics of historical figures born after 1800, after bust-up with Hearts of Iron 4 players over Atatürk banning
articles.summary: Hearts of Iron 4 developers Paradox Interactive have prohibited the use of Discord profile pictures of historical figures born after 1st January 1800, save for official in-game portraits, amid an uproar caused by a moderator banning somebody for using a photograph of Republic of Turkey founder…
body: Discord server members are still free to "use any official Hearts of Iron IV in-game portraits, including those from after 1800, with the exception of prominent leaders of Nazi Germany," according to a Discord post attributed to game director Laszlo "Batya" Pieper ( copied to Reddit ). In the same post, Pieper notes that "Paradox never aims to review history or take positions on political figures, and we clearly handled that responsibility poorly."

The whole furore began last week. I'm not able to get hold of the incendiary moderator post, because Paradox have now restricted access to their Discord and removed some threads, but according to a number of angry emails sent to RPS, the mod in question described Atatürk as controversial, with reference to his disputed involvement in the Armenian genocide of 1913-1922. As reported by Strategy and Wargaming, Paradox games have weathered a few review bombs on Steam over the past week, apparently in response to the ban. It seems likely that the ill will builds on disgruntlement about Hearts of Iron 4's lack of official Turkish language support.

articles.title: 5 Detective Books That Are Page-Turners From Start to Finish
articles.summary: Detective stories can take many forms, but here are five genre books that are engrossing page-turners from start to finish.
body: Everybody loves a good detective story. They satisfy our natural curiosity for solvable mysteries, allowing us to slip into the shoes of competent detectives like Sherlock Holmes or Hercule Poirot. There’s a sense of satisfaction to following a trail of clues, identifying red herrings, and theorizing before the answers are revealed. Good detective stories use grounded settings to heighten anxiety and embrace some amount of chaos before bringing about a neat resolution.

Horowitz’s novel is a page-turner for many reasons. It cushions an intriguing period-piece mystery inside its modern narrative, letting readers get engrossed by these parallel cases. These metanarratives are inevitably connected, which adds to the fun of hunting for clues and connecting any possible dots. The novel is a brilliant homage to classic Golden Age whodunits by Agatha Christie and Dorothy Sayers, which often dwell on the nostalgia of a complicated suburban mystery.

articles.title: 35 Years Later, the '90s Remake of a Cult Classic Thriller Is Officially Free to Watch on YouTube
articles.summary: A young woman embarks on an unexpected journey. Despite the excitement and possibilities of her future, there’s also fear. She boards a train that will take her to a new home atop a stormy cliff at the edge of the sea, a place defined by the fog and its history.
body: This premise might sound like it’s from a classic Gothic story like Jane Eyre or The Turn of the Screw. But it’s actually from 1991’s Dark Shadows: The Revival, an NBC series that distilled the long-running original Dark Shadows soap opera into a 12-episode melodrama. It’s the best way to enter the world created by horror icon Dan Curtis, and it’s streaming in full on YouTube.

Dark Shadows: The Revival follows Victoria Winters (Joanna Going), a governess who takes a job in the fishing town of Collinsport, Maine. She’ll reside in Collinwood, a manor owned by the Collins family, a generations-old dynasty. As Victoria settles into her new position, the supernatural kicks in: the groundskeeper unknowingly awakens a malevolent creature, putting the whole town in danger.

Barnabas Collins is one of television’s most memorable creations. Introduced as a 200-year-old vampire, he became the unexpected center of the Dark Shadows franchise, and the star of Hollywood adaptations (including Tim Burton's 2012 movie), novel tie-ins, and more.

articles.title: Former Dragon Age executive producer Mark Darrah explains what he'd change about each game: 'It's kind of filler'
articles.summary: Over on Tiktok, Mark Darrah was asked, "If you could go back in time what would you remove from each of the Dragon Age games and what would you add?" Like everyone who ever installed the Skip the Fade mod for Dragon Age: Origins, Darrah thinks the Lost in Dreams quest needs a snip.
body: As for what he'd add to the original, Darrah suggested the planned human origin where you'd get to play one of the avvar in the Korcari Wilds. "I would like to have another human origin," he said, "but wow, what an expensive add."

For Dragon Age 2, Darrah would remove one of the things I found frustrating about it—no matter whether you side with the templars or the mages, you're forced to fight both at the end. Even if you side with Orsino and the Circle of Magi he wigs out from blood magic, proving Meredith and the templars right in believing the mages are "barely tethered nuclear bombs" who do deserve "to be treated as non-humans."

articles.title: PSA: The Witcher 3 Remastered File Size And Release Time Confirmed, Separate Purchase Required
articles.summary: No automatic upgrades here. The Witcher III: Wild Hunt - Remastered is right around the corner, launching on Switch 2 on 29th September 2026 (yes, that's tomorrow at the time of writing).
body: Many of you already own the original Switch release, so the good news is that this new version is completely free for you. However, unlike PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, which automatically upgrade the original game to the Remastered version, you'll have to download a completely separate product on Switch 2.

This probably won't come as a huge surprise – it's generally the norm for Switch these days – but if you do happen to have the original game downloaded on your Switch 2 and you're sat twiddling your thumbs waiting for it to update, hold your horses.

Just head into the Switch 2 eShop, locate the new Remastered version, and you'll be able to download it at no extra cost. Pre-installations also began a few days back, so if you do it now, the game will fully download ready for its release on the 29th. For those who own a physical copy of the original, a previous notice from CDPR's customer support notes that you'll be able to claim your free upgrade on launch day.
"If you own a physical copy, don’t worry - you’ll be able to claim the free upgrade when Remastered launches on September 29."

articles.title: Steam Week in Review: Great, haystack slop is a thing now
articles.summary: All the interesting Steam facts for the week ending September 27.
body: Clones have been a fixture in the games industry forever. For every Mario Bros there's a Giana Sisters, for every Stardew Valley there's a Fields of Mistria, and for every Needle In A Haystack Simulator there's a A Needle In a Haystack, or Needle in a Haystack, or Needle In A Haystack, or Needle In A Haystack - A Time For Goats, or Story of The Needle In a Haystack.

The total slopification of Steam continues apace and the recent spray of haystack games is the purest manifestation of this phenomenon. The first—as far as I can tell—was Needle In A Haystack Simulator, which is scheduled for release in Q4 2026. According to developers Studio Bitdot, a playtest in August attracted around 23,000 players, which is an astonishing figure for a game about finding a needle in a haystack.
